svg.text: Plate 60 x 60 mm, 6 mm, corners rounded 3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Center hole 16.5 mm for the antenna's N-type bulkhead.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 5.5 mm holes at 20 mm each way from center,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: matching the M5 tapped holes in the post cap.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the cap with four M5 screws and a bead of sealant;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bulkhead passes through the plate and the cap's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 mm hole, nut underneath, coax down the post.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the antenna stands vertical within 2 degrees.
